class.name: FlowGraphPlayer
class.brief_description: Plays a [FlowGraph] in the scene tree.

method.name: get_playback
method.description: Returns the playback of this player.

method.name: is_playing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the graph plays. See [method FlowGraphPlayback.is_playing].

method.name: play
method.description: Starts [member graph] at [param from_id], or at its start node for [code]-1[/code]. See [method FlowGraphPlayback.start]. Returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] without a graph.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the player plays [member graph] when it is ready (not in the editor).
An optional blackboard for the variables, for example one shared by several players. If [code]null[/code], the playback uses its own blackboard.

constants.constant: Process waiting nodes during physics frames ([constant Node.NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PHYSICS_PROCESS]).
Process waiting nodes during process frames ([constant Node.NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PROCESS]).
Do not process; call [method FlowGraphPlayback.process] yourself.
Represents the size of the [enum CallbackModeProcess] enum.
